name: Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment
old_description: As a busy professional, you can count on Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment for a huge assortment of products, the lowest prices, and superior customer service from our showroom-based staff.
about:
Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment operates from a showroom and warehouse at 718 Main Street in Reisterstown, Maryland. The company was founded in 1997 and has served the Mid-Atlantic region for over two decades. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The business distributes a broad range of medical equipment and supplies through both a physical showroom and an online store. Its local warehouse allows many Maryland customers to receive orders without the shipping delays common with distant retailers. The staff provides product consultation to help clients select appropriate items for their specific needs.

Customers include doctor’s offices, clinics, rehabilitation centers, nursing homes, assisted living communities, and physical therapy practices throughout Maryland and the surrounding area. The company also directs consumer referrals to a separate retail site, MedicalSupplySale.com.

The company emphasizes its local presence and trained showroom staff as key differentiators, aiming to simplify product selection for healthcare professionals and support independent living for patients. Its tagline, “Making Independent Living Easier…Since 1997,” reflects this mission.
